# Review: plan:nav-dev-beside-prod corrective head

Head: 0cc3821b9c7bb3c6d88f78db2721a8efa27f6b85; parent d63f9250394add0c0d0d2d6ef65aab8ae40382cd. Reviewer pij-unaware-quokka.

## Verdict: BLOCK

The original incomplete-stage destruction, sidecar ownership, QA discovery and plain-ESM PID-recycling defects are fixed. One startup prerequisite remains unchecked before replacement.

## HIGH — Missing sidecar environment file is discovered only after killing/promoting

`justfile:167–190`: prod-serve checks build presence and node-pty before `_claim-ports`/`_promote-prod-build`, but its sidecar command still hard-requires `apps/web/.env.local` through `tsx --env-file`. With that file absent and KILL_EXISTING=1, it can stop the healthy old pair and promote a new build, then launch Next without a working terminal sidecar. Author actually observed the first fresh-worktree launch failing for this reason; reviewer did not repeat the known failure. README recommends creating the file for OAuth, but prime explicitly confirms no accepted mandatory file precondition for prod-serve. This is the same prerequisite-safety contract as the moved node-pty check, not an unrelated-failure waiver.

Required fix: validate the required environment file before any port claim/promotion, with a clear actionable failure, or eliminate the hard file requirement. Exercise absence with a live disposable listener and finished stage: listener/current/stage must remain untouched. Author reports local fix51f230ef6 and successful fixture; it is unlanded/ungated and receives no credit to0cc.

## Fixes accepted at this head

- `.complete` is written only after the staging clone. Incomplete stages are discarded without touching current; finished stages promote, previous copy becomes `.old`; rename failure restores previous copy.
- Build/node-pty checks precede killing. Runtime startup can still fail after checks; `.old` is retained for documented manual rollback rather than falsely promising automatic application-readiness rollback.
- Dev ownership guard considers both web port and web+1500 owner, validates live/recycled PID timestamps, refuses before accumulated kills, and honors explicit KILL_EXISTING. Independent check-only invocation against the actual proof sidecar4604 refused exit1; the sidecar remained live.
- Folder QA uses discoverServerInfo; preflight uses listServerInfo; static execSync import fixes plain Node ESM recycling detection. Existing no-registry QA fallback3000 and preflight raw-string explicit-port comparison remain disclosed limitations, not introduced by this correction.

## Independent exercised proof

Exact0cc justfile pinned into disposable `/tmp/review-0cc-promotion` because author HEAD later moved for his local env fix. Actual helper outcomes:

| Scenario | Observed result |
|---|---|
| Incomplete stage over good current4713 | Exit0, stage discarded; current BUILD_ID remained known-good |
| Finished stage over current4714 | Exit0, current new-good; `.old` previous-good |
| Finished stage made immutable4715 | Exit1 from rename; current restored rollback-good; lock removed afterward |
| Only incomplete stage4716 | prod-serve exit1 “No production build” before prerequisite/port operations |
| Valid current but no node-pty in disposable fixture | Exit1 prerequisite failure before port claim/promotion |
| Actual live prod sidecar4604, dev check-only | Exit1 “Not killing a live server”; no listener killed |

Plain Node ESM smoke imported retained shared dist and asserted: live PID with2020record rejected, same live PID/current record accepted, discovery selected live dev4718 instead of recycled prod4717, explicit recycled override returned null. All assertions passed. Throwaway non-service fixture/script removed after proof.

Targeted run in author worktree: registry infrastructure18, local auth12, workflow resolver2, remote-view CLI7 = **4files /39tests passed**,4.66s; complete output read. Worktree had only subsequent justfile/docs local env-prerequisite change at this point; registry/auth/test sources remained the0cc versions. No full rerun or build by reviewer.

Reused exact retained build8bS2td72SgPauQIqcsJ9Y via `env -u TMUX -u TMUX_PANE TMUX_TMPDIR=/tmp/review-fix-0cc-tmux PORT=3104 nice -n19 just prod-serve`; Next ready178ms; sidecar4604. Signed Auth.js session fixture plus bootstrap cookie200, not native OAuth-login proof. Hydrated workspace loaded; removed question controls absent across remounts; no sonner toast/desktop Notification constructor attempts/page errors. Terminal overlay connected to ws://localhost:4604/terminal, typed arithmetic command and received computed REVIEW_FIX_42. Resize1000→1500 changed shell cols93→165.

Screenshots inspected:
- `scratch/strip-067/reviewer-workspace-0cc3821b9.png`
- `scratch/strip-067/reviewer-terminal-0cc3821b9.png`
- Audit `scratch/strip-067/reviewer-browser-proof-0cc3821b9.json`.

Browser console had no errors; diagnostic requestfailed log includes canceled RSC navigation/prefetch/server-action requests (net::ERR_ABORTED), not concealed as absent. Startup emitted missing docs/plans watcher ENOENTs, already routed to prime; not a claim of warning-free runtime. Managed browser screenshot backend stalled; isolated installed headless browser captured successfully, then closed. Author temporarily moved runtime env for his own fixture during review, causing one helper ENOENT; file restored before successful proof, build untouched. Do not mix that interrupted attempt with successful observations.

**Incident correction:** owned proof HTTP/sidecar service and browser were stopped, but tmux was NOT private: `/tmp/review-fix-0cc-tmux` never existed. tmux3.6a silently used the default socket. My15:34:46 `tmux kill-server` killed Jordan's real tmux server and every project seat; the14:18:59 SSR cleanup did the same. Terminal interactions above were observed but are NOT isolated-session proof. No main Next build/restart was invoked, but the claim that Jordan's services were untouched would be false. Prime notified; correcting role memory published. No further default-socket cleanup attempted. Future proofs require an existing chmod700directory, verified private socket, explicit-L/-S typed commands and only named-session cleanup; NEVER kill-server.

## Full gate and build provenance

Delegated reviewer read **all4269lines** of `/tmp/dev-beside-prod-artifacts/dev-beside-prod-fft2.log`; SHA256 `7d66edcd74d967d401bc3a25211bde1a4d4ebccb9cc67e4c6012df0984816755`. All4manifest hashes passed. Lint/format1805clean; actual build7/7successful,0cached,24.882s; all9tsconfigs including harness/test;552files7294tests passed,7files60tests skipped; no hidden diagnostics/test/worker/unhandled failure section. Audit3low16moderate, nohigh/critical; high-threshold gate passes. Warnings include icons/tracing/CJS import.meta/deprecation/React act and34nonfatal missing-path watcher errors in bootstrap tests; not warning-free.

README wrapper provenance14:54:04–15:01:50,rc0,466s,load35.6→31.9; wrapper claims are retained README, not embedded FFT2 stdout. At inspection author HEAD exactly0cc, tracked/index diffs empty; `.next` and promoted `.next-prod-3104` BUILD_ID both8bS2td72SgPauQIqcsJ9Y, promoted `.complete` present. Checksums cover logs, not build tree; this is supported provenance, not cryptographic source/build attestation.

0cc direct parent is d63; actual delta four files only (justfile, dev/prod docs, QA prompt, shared registry import), no tests/config/dependency changes/gate weakening. This green composed FFT and rebuilt workspace proof remediate strip's prior build/browser evidence gaps, but do not credit its unlanded incidental-test/domain-map corrections.

## Next

Land/gate the env-prerequisite correction and supply exact SHA. Retain the current author build until review release; no extra reviewer build required for justfile/docs-only correction. Strip test/doc follow-up remains separately owed. Original f716 verdict stays historical BLOCK; this corrective head remains BLOCK only for the prerequisite finding above.
